cost: O(path bytes+cwd bytes) time/storage; join/child/base_name linear in observed string lengths.
forward: check rejects empty, NUL, then length>4096 in that order. normalize starts at [] for absolute else cwd clone; drops empty/dot; dotdot pops or escapes unless clamp; other components checked<=255 bytes. join([])=/.
inverse: Normalized /b/c admits /b//c, /b/./c and relative spellings with suitable cwd; canceled prefix information cannot be reconstructed. Empty output admits /, /., and balanced paths.
limitations: Finite checks only; partial source syntax, no expanded semantic AST.
No numerical surrogate: categorical/effect semantics lack useful metric; future caps 1/2/5/10 require domain and reference.
state: Successful normalization under clamp=false never pops above root. UTF8 lengths are bytes; lexical normalization does not resolve links. Caller-provided cwd is assumed canonical.
